name: Cigarette c:
description:
CIG COIN is a meme token built on a single image: a cigarette that has burned down. No technology, no roadmap — just a mood. End of the day, last cigarette before sleep, the moment when nobody wants anything from you.

Every CIG is one break you will never get back. No staking, no double rewards — just a community of people who smoke too much and have no intention of doing anything about it.

CIG COIN is not a project about the future. It is about now, about the moment between one cigarette and the next.
